Horrible!

reviews.title: Ai and standard are useless r.e n sound motion missed
reviews.text:
Not capturing most sound and motion (of all type e.g pet/person/vehicle etc) that it should be. And from about 7pm onwards this increases drastically on missing/not recording when it should be triggered. The from 10pm almost nothing that should be detected and subsequently recorded ever is anymore until about 7.30/8am the following morning…and this is where it’s needed most. Unreliable even though my settings have always been on the highest sensitivity for motion and sound (set to whisper sensitivity) which doesn’t even capture loud noises and disturbances outside. 

Also the quality of the recordings and audio is incredibly poor, unreliable and unclear breaking up and constant silent bursts so not all audio is captured in the recordings. 

I’ve had this to protect the safety of myself and family within the household due to serious incident by which I must inherently protect myself and my family against any further harm, sort this out Ive already paid for premium and I purchased two of your official cameras (both are the plus 2 models) which are not fit for purpose, fix this! These are for the safety and protection of people and their properties..but currently you are failing with this. 

Please take action to rectify and resolve the issue immediately, thank you.

reviews.title: Buggy, doesn’t record movement
reviews.text: Does not record actual movement, e.g. someone entering through the door. Instead, it sends false movement alerts and shows altered footage, e.g. the recorded space at 7 pm appears brighter than it did at 5 pm. Scam. Even with a paid subscription, the app does not run smoothly, customer support is extremely difficult to reach, and data protection rules are unclear.

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: For 28$ per month I expect this app to work properly. It’s always turning off and I need to constantly reconnect it throughout the day. The resolution sucks even at full HD. You are better off buying a cheap camera from TikTok shop or Temu because thats the quality this app should be compared to. Not worth 7$ per week

The most stupid thing I’ve experienced. I am canceling my subscription.

reviews.title: Insecure app
reviews.text: Tried the app and it’s not secure. The monitoring device cannot be screen locked. If a hotel worker were to pick up your device while it was monitoring your room they would have full access to your phone, any accounts, apps, iCloud, etc. The screen also stays on and says that it is recording. Cancelled my subscription 10 minutes after installing the app. 👎🏻

It’s become increasingly unusable at each app update, the mismanagement and terrible leadership have removed every useful feature and replaced it with the cheapest of advertising videos. Looking out the window yourself is more useful than this app. I use to recommend it, but rescind that now. Good luck trying to use it for anything at all.

reviews.title: Dont waste your time

reviews.title: Unable to cancel, then charged. BEWARE!
reviews.text: I downloaded the app to use the free trial and see if this would be what I needed. My standard practice is to immediately cancel my subscriptions so I am not charged. I went into my subscriptions in my Apple account and did not see Alfred. It was odd. Then three days later I got an email that my trial had ended and I was charged. I went into my subscriptions and still did not see the subscription or anyway to cancel it that I was still charged. I reached out to Alfred support about canceling and they referred me to Apple and told me the process to go through. I responded that the subscription was not even showing up. It finally showed up five days after the fact and the amount was taken out of my PayPal account. I contacted Apple for a refund but they said it was too late even though there was no way I could have tried to cancel earlier. I found the app difficult to use. Now I'm stuck with a year subscription that I won't use that no one will refund.

Surely we can come up with a better solution than requiring signing up for the trial just to see if the app even works at all.

reviews.title: Literally worse than nothing
reviews.text: I can’t see the video feed for more than three seconds without some ad popup pretending to be a system error blocks my screen for up to 90 seconds with only fake close buttons. Also, when viewing the feed from two floors down, I kept getting feedback noises that sounded as if they were coming from the camera- but then I recognized that the feedback was happening when I made noise at the viewer device location. So that mic is active even when the viewer is not activating the speak function. Everything about this app is shady, and I just happily gave my money to another company to buy a camera rather than ever consider upgrading this.

reviews.title: Don’t go down this rabbit hole …
reviews.text:
This app is garbage unless you are willing to pay for a premium subscription.  Every feature REQUIRES you to pay the subscription fee.  Wanna rewind the recording- not for free.  Wanna zoom in or out - not for free.  Wanna use high quality resolution - not for free.  The list of “no” goes on and on.  

Someone got greedy (venture capital?) and changed the app, so they could make more money.  The free version could make money for its investors, if they better used targeted advertising.  Save yourself some headaches and just buy a WiFi camera.  Don’t take my word for it though, check out the recent reviews of the free version (spoiler alert, they are lower than a gopher’s basement) and look when the app changes were made.   A real WiFi camera has more features at a reduced overall cost.
